test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The seller shall dispatch the parcel soon to Chennai.

options.text: The parcel will be dispatched soon to Chennai by the seller.
The parcel may be dispatched by the seller to Chennai soon.
The parcel might be dispatched by the seller to Chennai soon.
The parcel can be dispatched by the seller to Chennai soon.

solution:
The correct passive voice is: **The parcel will be dispatched soon to Chennai by the seller.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in active voice, with the subject '**seller**' performing the action '**dispatch**'.
 
• To convert it into passive voice, we need to make the object '**parcel**' the subject, and use the auxiliary verb '**will be**' along with the past participle form of the main verb '**dispatched**'.
 
• The preposition '**to Chennai**' remains unchanged as it indicates the destination.
 
• The agent (**seller**) is introduced with the preposition '**by**' at the end of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2**: The use of 'may' indicates possibility, but the original sentence is in future tense and not conditional.
 
• **Option 3**: The use of 'might' indicates uncertainty, but the original sentence is a statement of fact.
 
• **Option 4**: The use of 'can' indicates ability, but the original sentence is not about capability but intention.
